cases.job_description:
Backend Engineer, Payments Platform

About the role
You will build and operate backend services that move and record money for online businesses. The team owns payment processing, ledgers and the webhooks that notify customers of events.

What you will do
- Design and build highly reliable backend services in Go or Java
- Own the correctness of financial data, including reconciliation of transactions across systems
- Design idempotent, retry-safe APIs and webhook delivery
- Improve latency and availability of services that handle high request volume
- Work with product and support teams to debug production issues

Requirements
- 4+ years of experience building backend services
- Strong knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL
- Experience designing REST APIs
- Experience with event streaming or message queues
- Comfort being on call for the services you own

Nice to have
- Experience with card payments or ledger systems
- Experience with Ruby
- Experience with formal API versioning practices

cases.job_description:
Site Reliability Engineer, Platform Infrastructure

About the role
You will help keep a large, multi-region cloud platform reliable. The team builds the tooling and practices that let product engineers run their own services safely.

What you will do
- Operate and scale container orchestration clusters across multiple cloud regions
- Define, measure and alert on service level objectives
- Lead incident response and write blameless postmortems
- Automate infrastructure provisioning and reduce operational toil
- Improve monitoring, tracing and logging coverage for internal services

Requirements
- 3+ years of experience in site reliability or infrastructure engineering
- Hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production
- Experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform
- Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python or Rust
- Participation in an on-call rotation

Nice to have
- Experience with large-scale time series data
- Experience with service mesh or eBPF tooling
- Experience mentoring engineers on reliability practices

Software Engineer, Business Banking Products

About the role
You will build customer-facing and internal software for a business banking product used by startups and small companies. The team ships features end to end, from database to user interface.

What you will do
- Build and maintain APIs for accounts, transfers and payments
- Integrate with banking partners and third-party compliance vendors
- Build user interfaces in React and TypeScript
- Write tests and monitor the features you ship
- Collaborate with design, risk and operations teams

Requirements
- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong TypeScript and Node.js skills
- Experience with SQL databases
- Experience building or consuming financial or banking APIs
- Care for security and correctness in systems that handle money

Nice to have
- Experience with ACH or wire transfer systems
- Experience with identity verification (KYC) integrations
- Experience at an early-stage company
